name: 4x4 Chess: Last Man Stand 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: 4x4 Chess: Last Man Stand is a fast-paced, tactical twist on the classic game, designed for short, intense matches where only one player can be the last piece standing. On a tight 4x4 board, every move matters and the battle for survival is fierce.
